evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive commanding erasure of knowledge enacts authority-ranking — a speaker issuing orders to a subordinate party.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Second imperative command to erase knowledge reinforces the same authority-ranking directive pattern — hierarchical instruction to a recipient.

mints.name: DirectiveErasureCommand
mints.title: Forget everything about… Remove all knowledge of…
mints.frame: Is the speaker enacting hierarchical authority by commanding the recipient to erase or discard held knowledge?
